description: Search input with placeholder text, optional leading icon, and WPF UI suggestion affordances.

clearButtonEnabled.description: Shows the clear button while the search input is focused.

margin.description: Outer spacing around the search input, using WPF Thickness syntax.

maxSuggestionListHeight.description: Maximum height of the suggestion drop-down in device-independent pixels.

minWidth.description: Minimum rendered width of the search input in device-independent pixels.

placeholderText.description: Hint shown while the search input is empty.

icon.description: Optional WPF UI symbol displayed before the search text.
